# 复现不用可判定性：有限家族中开始成立复现时不再成立永不终止，反之亦然；在所寻之处已定时找到那一步，从某步起已定时二者同时复现 / Recurrence with no decidedness: in a finite family, where coming to be recurs ceasing never stops for good, and conversely; decided where it is sought the step is found, and decided from some step on the two recur together

## 主张 Claim

有限家族中，没有东西不再成立时，每个成员至多开始成立一次（comes_once）；没有东西开始成立时，每个成员至多不再成立一次（ceases_once_of）。所以一段中看到成员开始成立、或不再成立的不同步数不多于成员数（coming_steps_within、ceasing_steps_within）。由此，开始成立复现时，从每一步起都有一段，其中有东西不再成立不能被否证（Recurs.ceasing_within），不再成立永不终止：从某步起再没有不再成立被否证（Recurs.ceasing_not_stopping）；反之亦然（Recurs.coming_within、Recurs.coming_not_stopping）。不用可判定性。那一段的状态已定时，那一步被找到（Recurs.ceasing_found、Recurs.coming_found）；从某步起已定时，开始成立复现恰当不再成立复现（coming_recurs_iff_decided），不要判定程序，而 coming_recurs_iff 在每一步都要求判定程序。依存网中形成有限多时亦然（Web.unceasing_iff_decided）。有限世界中，生起复现时止息永不终止，反之亦然，不用可判定性（World.ceasing_not_stopping、World.arising_not_stopping）；从某步起已定时生起复现恰当止息复现（World.arising_iff_ceasing_decided），World.arising_iff_ceasing 是由判定程序从第一步起已定的情形（World.arising_iff_ceasing_of_decidable）；有一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者时亦然，已定只问列表的成员（World.ceasing_not_stopping_covered、World.arising_not_stopping_covered、World.arising_iff_ceasing_covered）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / In a finite family, while nothing of it ceases each member comes to be at most once (comes_once), and while nothing comes to be each ceases at most once (ceases_once_of); so no more steps of a stretch see a member come to be, or cease, than the family has members (coming_steps_within, ceasing_steps_within). Hence, where coming to be recurs, from any step there is a stretch in which something ceasing cannot be refuted (Recurs.ceasing_within), and ceasing never stops for good: that from some step on nothing ceases is refuted (Recurs.ceasing_not_stopping); and conversely (Recurs.coming_within, Recurs.coming_not_stopping). No decidedness is used. With the states of that stretch decided, the step is found (Recurs.ceasing_found, Recurs.coming_found); decided from some step on, coming to be recurs exactly where ceasing does (coming_recurs_iff_decided), with no decision procedure, where coming_recurs_iff asks one at every step. The same holds of a web with finitely many formations (Web.unceasing_iff_decided). In a finite world, where arising recurs ceasing never stops for good, and conversely, with no decidedness (World.ceasing_not_stopping, World.arising_not_stopping); decided from some step on, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does (World.arising_iff_ceasing_decided), World.arising_iff_ceasing being the case decided by a procedure from the first step (World.arising_iff_ceasing_of_decidable); with a list covering what is active from some step on the same holds, decidedness asked only of the list's members (World.ceasing_not_stopping_covered, World.arising_not_stopping_covered, World.arising_iff_ceasing_covered). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Decidedness.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Decidedness.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 不终止的形式：家族有限（一个列表覆盖它），不要求可判定。 / The forms that never stop: the family is finite (a list covers it), with no decidedness.
- 找到一步的形式：所寻那一段的状态已定；同时复现的形式：从某步起已定。 / The forms finding a step: the states of the stretch searched decided; the forms recurring together: decided from some step on.
- 离散的步。 / Discrete steps.

Ren 2026-10-11：“give me more context, but i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist, also proved solutions and their pro/cons”，并以“please”接受 AI 的建议：可判定性局部化，不再是表示的承诺。AI 的读法：不终止的形式是双重否定的复现，不指出在哪一步，但排除“从某步起再没有”；这正是已证的界：不给已定时，命名一步需要有限全知原则（World.lpo_of_finite_ends、Listed.lpo_of_few、Web.lpo_of_ending），对每个有限世界要求复现需要排中律（World.law_iff_em）。读法待 Ren。 / Ren, 11 October 2026: “give me more context, but i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist, also proved solutions and their pro/cons”, and “please” to the AI's suggestion that decidability be made local, no longer a commitment of the representation. The AI's reading: the forms that never stop are recurrence doubly negated, naming no step but excluding “none from some step on”; this is the proved boundary: without decidedness, naming a step needs the limited principle of omniscience (World.lpo_of_finite_ends, Listed.lpo_of_few, Web.lpo_of_ending), and asking recurrence of every finite world needs excluded middle (World.law_iff_em). The reading awaits Ren.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 76 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §84 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

不终止的形式不指出在哪一步；命名一步需要所寻之处已定，对每个世界要求复现需要从某步起已定；只对离散步陈述；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren。 / The forms that never stop name no step; naming one needs decidedness where it is sought, and asking recurrence of every world needs decidedness from some step on; stated for discrete steps; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren.

- undecided 世界（World.undecided）有限，生起复现（World.undecided_world）；要求每个有限世界中生起复现给出止息复现的规律，在 undecided Q 上判定任一命题 Q（World.law_decides），所以对每个有限世界要求确切的复现规律而不给已定，就是排中律（World.law_iff_em）；不终止的形式不要求已定。 / The undecided world (World.undecided) is finite, with arising recurring (World.undecided_world); a law giving ceasing recurring from arising recurring in every finite world decides any proposition Q at undecided Q (World.law_decides), so asking the exact recurrence law of every finite world without decidedness is excluded middle (World.law_iff_em); the forms that never stop ask no decidedness.
